scheme_name: Farmer Producer Organisation (FPO) Equity Grant Fund
overview: The Farmer Producer Organisation (FPO) Equity Grant Fund is a scheme under the Central Sector Scheme for Formation and Promotion of 10,000 Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs) implemented by the Small Farmers' Agri-Business Consortium (SFAC). It provides matching equity grants to Farmer Producer Companies (FPCs) to improve availability of working capital and support business development. The scheme aims to strengthen the equity base of FPOs and promote sustainable agribusiness through financial support and handholding.
objectives: To provide matching equity grants to Farmer Producer Companies (FPCs) to improve availability of working capital
To support development of business activities of FPOs
To promote formation and growth of Farmer Producer Organizations/Farmer Producer Companies across the country
To establish an ecosystem for FPOs/FPCs to make them sustainable and viable in the long run
To increase incomes of small and marginal farmers through aggregation and development of agribusiness
eligibility: Farmer Producer Companies (FPCs) registered under Part IXA of the Companies Act or under Co-operative Societies Act of the concerned States, formed for the purpose of leveraging collectives through economies of scale in production and marketing of agricultural and allied sector, and seeking equity grant for working capital and business development activities.
benefits: Financial support in the form of matching equity grant to strengthen the equity base of FPOs; non-financial benefits include handholding support from Cluster Based Business Organizations (CBBOs), capacity building, market linkages, credit linkages, and technical guidance for sustainable agribusiness development.
financial_support: The scheme provides matching equity grant subject to a maximum of Rs. 15.00 lakh per FPO in 3 tranches within a period of 3 Years. The grant is released based on the equity contribution made by the FPO shareholders and is intended to improve availability of working capital and development of business activities.
grant_amount_per_entity: Up to Rs. 15.00 lakh per FPO
application_process: 1. Application on prescribed form duly signed by two Board Members/Authorised Representative of FPC on each page. 2. Submit category wise allotment pattern of shares of FPC and proposed computation of allotment of shares out of Equity Grant as per Annexure-I. 3. Submit Resolution of the FPC Board/Governing Council to seek Equity Grant, issue of shares to shareholders against Equity Grant and transfer of shares in case of exit of any shareholder as per Annexure-II. 4. Submit Resolution to be ratified in the next AGM of the FPC as per Annexure-III. 5. Submit Resolution (No appointment letter required) for appointment of Chief Executive Officer of Company. 6. Submit Audited Financial Statements for last financial year. 7. Submit Photocopy of Bank Account Statement for last six months duly authenticated by the Branch Manager of the Bank. 8. Submit KYC documents of only those Representatives/Directors authorised by the Board of FPC for executing and signing documents with SFAC. 9. Submit Certificate of incorporation/commencement of business, Memorandum of Association/Articles of Association. 10. Submit Business plan for 18 months.
required_documents: Application on prescribed form duly signed by two Board Members/Authorised Representative of FPC on each page
Category wise allotment pattern of shares of FPC and proposed computation of allotment of shares out of Equity Grant as per Annexure-I

Resolution of the FPC Board/Governing Council to seek Equity Grant, issue of shares to the shareholders against Equity Grant and transfer of shares (issued against Equity Grant) in case of exit of any shareholder from FPC as per Annexure-II
Resolution (No appointment letter required) for appointment of Chief Executive officer of Company
Audited Financial Statements for last financial year
Photocopy of Bank Account Statement for last six months duly authenticated by the Branch Manager of the Bank
KYC documents of only those Representatives/Directors authorised by the Board of FPC for executing and signing documents with SFAC
Certificate of incorporation/commencement of business, Memorandum of Association/Articles of Association
caveats: Equity Grant is subject to maximum of Rs. 15.00 lakh per FPO
Grant is released in 3 tranches within a period of 3 Years
Requires matching equity contribution from FPO shareholders
FPC must be registered under Part IXA of Companies Act or Co-operative Societies Act
Business plan for 18 months is mandatory
